```{r}

fit_linear_structural_model <- function(Y_train, Z_train, A,
                                        alpha = 0,       # 0=ridge, 1=lasso
                                        lambda = NULL,   # optional fixed lambda
                                        pb_title = "Per-gene SEM Fit (glmnet/OLS)") {
  
  Y_train <- as.matrix(Y_train)
  Z_train <- as.matrix(Z_train)
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  
  n <- nrow(Y_train)
  p <- ncol(Y_train)
  
  B <- matrix(0, nrow = p, ncol = p)
  C <- matrix(0, nrow = p, ncol = p)
  intercepts <- numeric(p)
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------
  # Progress bar
  # ------------------------------------------------------
  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = paste0(pb_title,
                    " [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta: :eta"),
    total = p,
    clear = FALSE,
    width = 70
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------
  # Fit each gene j
  # ------------------------------------------------------
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    pb$tick()
    
    parents <- which(A[, j] == 1)
    y <- Y_train[, j]
    
    # ======================================================
    # CASE 1: No parents → use simple OLS: y ~ Z_j
    # ======================================================
    if (length(parents) == 0) {
      
      df <- data.frame(y = y,
                       z = Z_train[, j])
      fit <- lm(y ~ z, data = df)
      
      intercepts[j] <- coef(fit)[1]
      C[j, j] <- coef(fit)[2]
      
      next
    }
    
    # ======================================================
    # CASE 2: Has parents → use glmnet
    # ======================================================
    X_design <- cbind(
      Y_train[, parents, drop = FALSE],
      Z_train[, j, drop = FALSE]
    )
    
    fit <- glmnet(x = X_design, y = y, alpha = alpha, intercept = TRUE)
    
    # CV-based lambda unless user gave one
    if (is.null(lambda)) {
      cv <- cv.glmnet(x = X_design, y = y, alpha = alpha, intercept = TRUE)
      lambda_use <- cv$lambda.1se
    } else {
      lambda_use <- lambda
    }
    
    coef_j <- coef(fit, s = lambda_use)
    
    intercepts[j] <- as.numeric(coef_j[1])
    beta <- as.numeric(coef_j[-1])
    
    # Parent coefficients → B
    B[parents, j] <- beta[seq_along(parents)]
    
    # Self-perturbation coefficient → C
    C[j, j] <- beta[length(parents) + 1]
  }
  
  list(B = B, C = C, intercepts = intercepts)
}



predict_expression <- function(Z, B, C, intercepts = NULL) {
  Z <- as.matrix(Z)
  B <- as.matrix(B)
  C <- as.matrix(C)

  p <- ncol(Z)
  I <- diag(p)

  M <- solve(I - B)  # (I - B)^{-1}

  Y_pred <- Z %*% C %*% M

  if (!is.null(intercepts)) {
    Y_pred <- sweep(Y_pred, 2, intercepts, FUN = "+")
  }

  Y_pred
}


predict_expression <- function(Z, B, C, intercepts = NULL) {
  Z <- as.matrix(Z)
  B <- as.matrix(B)
  C <- as.matrix(C)

  p <- ncol(Z)
  I <- diag(p)

  M <- solve(I - B)  # (I - B)^{-1}

  Y_pred <- Z %*% C %*% M

  if (!is.null(intercepts)) {
    Y_pred <- sweep(Y_pred, 2, intercepts, FUN = "+")
  }

  Y_pred
}
```

```{r}
merge_experiment_results <- function(experiment_results_base, experiment_results_hub) {
  tps <- intersect(names(experiment_results_base), names(experiment_results_hub))
  if (length(tps) == 0L) stop("No common timepoints between base and hub results.")
  setNames(
    lapply(tps, function(tp) {
      # rows = experiments, cols = genes
      s_base <- experiment_results_base[[tp]][["stats"]]
      s_hub  <- experiment_results_hub [[tp]][["stats"]]
      if (is.null(s_base) || is.null(s_hub)) {
        stop("Missing $stats at timepoint: ", tp)
      }
      s_all <- rbind(s_base, s_hub)
      list(stats = s_all)
    }),
    tps
  )
}
```

```{r}
.get_mrna_cols <- function(nm) {
  idx <- grepl("^mol_mrna_", nm)
  if (!any(idx)) stop("No mRNA columns ('^mol_mrna_').")
  list(index = idx, prefix = "^mol_mrna_")
}

# Parse "..._mult<NUM>" (e.g., "EXP_7_mult0.05") -> numeric multiplier, default if absent
.parse_mult <- function(exp_name, default_mult = 0.005) {
  m <- regexpr("mult[0-9.]+$", exp_name, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] == -1) return(default_mult)
  as.numeric(sub("mult", "", regmatches(exp_name, m)))
}


extract_expression_and_design <- function(models,
                                          exp_design,
                                          wt_name = c("WT","HUB_WT"),
                                          time_range = NULL,
                                          scale_factor = 1e4) {
  
  stopifnot(!is.null(exp_design))
  
  Y_blocks <- list()
  Z_blocks <- list()
  obs_rows <- list()
  
  all_genes <- colnames(exp_design)   # gene order for perturbation matrix
  
  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = "Extracting Y/Z [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta: :eta",
    total = length(models), clear = FALSE, width = 70
  )
  
  for (e in names(models)) {
    pb$tick()
    m <- models[[e]]
    
    ## -----------------------------------------
    ## 1. subset time range
    ## -----------------------------------------
    meta <- m$simulations$meta
    if (!is.null(time_range)) {
      rows <- which(meta$sim_time >= time_range[1] &
                    meta$sim_time <= time_range[2])
    } else {
      rows <- which(meta$sim_time > 0)
    }
    if (!length(rows)) next
    
    ## -----------------------------------------
    ## 2. extract mRNA raw counts
    ## -----------------------------------------
    mc <- .get_mrna_cols(colnames(m$simulations$counts))
    E_raw <- as.matrix(m$simulations$counts[rows, mc$index, drop = FALSE])
    colnames(E_raw) <- sub(mc$prefix, "", colnames(E_raw))
    
    ## -----------------------------------------
    ## 3. library normalization + log1p
    ## -----------------------------------------
    libsize <- rowSums(E_raw)
    libsize[libsize == 0] <- 1
    E_norm <- sweep(E_raw, 1, libsize, FUN = "/") * scale_factor
    Y_block <- log1p(E_norm)
    
    ## -----------------------------------------
    ## 4. Build perturbation vector
    ## WT: all zeros
    ## others: take row from exp_design
    ## -----------------------------------------
    if (e %in% wt_name) {
      z_vec <- rep(0, length(all_genes))
      names(z_vec) <- all_genes
    } else {
      if (!e %in% rownames(exp_design)) {
        stop(paste("Experiment", e, "not in exp_design and not WT."))
      }
      z_vec <- as.numeric(exp_design[e, , drop = TRUE])
      z_vec[z_vec != 0] <- 1  # enforce binary
    }
    
    ## broadcast to match each cell
    Z_block <- matrix(rep(z_vec, each = length(rows)),
                      nrow = length(rows),
                      dimnames = list(NULL, all_genes))
    
    ## -----------------------------------------
    ## 5. store blocks
    ## -----------------------------------------
    cell_ids <- paste0(e, "_", seq_len(length(rows)))
    
    rownames(Y_block) <- cell_ids
    rownames(Z_block) <- cell_ids
    
    Y_blocks[[e]] <- Y_block
    Z_blocks[[e]] <- Z_block
    
    obs_rows[[e]] <- data.frame(
      cell_id = cell_ids,
      experiment = e,
      sim_time = meta$sim_time[rows],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  ## combine all
  Y <- do.call(rbind, Y_blocks)
  Z <- do.call(rbind, Z_blocks)
  obs <- do.call(rbind, obs_rows)
  
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(Y), rownames(Z)))
  
  list(Y = Y, Z = Z, obs = obs)
}
```

```{r}
sample_random_graph_same_edges <- function(A,
                                           allow_self_loops = FALSE) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- nrow(A)
  stopifnot(ncol(A) == p)
  
  # 原图边数
  m <- sum(A != 0)
  
  # 所有候选边位置 (i != j)，不允许自环
  if (!allow_self_loops) {
    cand <- which(row(A) != col(A), arr.ind = TRUE)
  } else {
    cand <- which(matrix(TRUE, nrow = p, ncol = p), arr.ind = TRUE)
  }
  
  n_cand <- nrow(cand)
  if (m > n_cand) {
    stop("Number of edges in input graph exceeds possible edges under current constraints.")
  }
  

  sel_idx <- sample(seq_len(n_cand), size = m, replace = FALSE)
  sel_edges <- cand[sel_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  

  A_rand <- matrix(0L, nrow = p, ncol = p)
  A_rand[as.matrix(sel_edges)] <- 1L
  

  diag(A_rand) <- 0L
  rownames(A_rand) <-rownames(A)
  colnames(A_rand) <- colnames(A)
  
  A_rand
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # just to fix the list of seeds (optional)

n_iter <- 10
seeds <- sample(1:100000, n_iter)   # ensure different seed each iteration

mae_global_list <- numeric(n_iter)
mae_cell_agg_list <- numeric(n_iter)

for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
  cat("Iteration:", i, "seed =", seeds[i], "\n")
  set.seed(seeds[i])

  # 1. random adjacency with same number of edges
  random_adj <- sample_random_graph_same_edges(adj_truth)

  # 2. fit structural model
  fitr <- fit_linear_structural_model(Y_train, Z_train, random_adj, alpha = 0)

  Br <- fitr$B
  Cr <- fitr$C
  intercepts_r <- fitr$intercepts

  # 3. predict test set
  Y_test_pred_rand_graph <- predict_expression(Z_test, Br, Cr, intercepts_r)

  # --------------------------
  # 4. MAE calculations
  # --------------------------

  # 4.1 global MAE across all cells and all genes
  mae_global <- mean(abs(Y_test - Y_test_pred_rand_graph))
  mae_global_list[i] <- mae_global

  # 4.2 per-cell aggregated AE (sum across genes) → then MAE
  AE <- abs(Y_test - Y_test_pred_rand_graph)
  AE_cell_agg <- rowSums(AE)
  MAE_final <- mean(AE_cell_agg)
  mae_cell_agg_list[i] <- MAE_final
}

# return results as a table
mae_results <- data.frame(
  iter = 1:n_iter,
  seed = seeds,
  mae_global = mae_global_list,
  mae_cell_agg = mae_cell_agg_list
)

mae_results
```

```{r}

get_ancestors <- function(adj) {
  p <- ncol(adj)
  ancestors <- vector("list", p)
  
  for (j in 1:p) {
    visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
    queue <- which(adj[, j] == 1)  # direct parents
    visited[queue] <- TRUE
    
    while (length(queue) > 0) {
      node <- queue[1]; queue <- queue[-1]
      new_parents <- which(adj[, node] == 1)
      new_parents <- new_parents[!visited[new_parents]]
      
      if (length(new_parents) > 0) {
        visited[new_parents] <- TRUE
        queue <- c(queue, new_parents)
      }
    }
    
    ancestors[[j]] <- which(visited)
  }
  
  ancestors  
}

  extra_are_indirect <- intersect(extra_par, ancestors_j)
  
  results_list[[g]] <- list(
    true_parents = colnames(adj_truth)[true_par],
    rand_parents = colnames(adj_truth)[rand_par],
    extra_rand_not_true = colnames(adj_truth)[extra_par],
    extra_indirect_ancestors = colnames(adj_truth)[extra_are_indirect],
    n_extra_par = length(extra_par),
    n_extra_indirect = length(extra_are_indirect)
  )
```

```{r}
.get_mrna_cols <- function(nm) {
  idx <- grepl("^mol_mrna_", nm)
  if (!any(idx)) stop("No mRNA columns ('^mol_mrna_').")
  list(index = idx, prefix = "^mol_mrna_")
}


# counts -> library-size normalized -> log1p
.log1p_libnorm <- function(count_mat) {
  lib <- rowSums(count_mat)
  lib[lib == 0] <- NA_real_
  norm <- sweep(count_mat, 1, lib, "/")
  log1p(norm)
}

# extract expression for one experiment
.get_expr <- function(models, exp_name, time_range = NULL) {
  m <- models[[exp_name]]
  meta <- m$simulations$meta

  if (!is.null(time_range)) {
    rows <- which(meta$sim_time >= time_range[1] &
                  meta$sim_time <= time_range[2])
  } else {
    rows <- which(meta$sim_time > 0)
  }
  if (!length(rows)) return(NULL)

  mc <- .get_mrna_cols(colnames(m$simulations$counts))
  E <- as.matrix(m$simulations$counts[rows, mc$index, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(E) <- sub(mc$prefix, "", colnames(E))

  .log1p_libnorm(E)
}




```

```{r}
compute_top200_de_per_experiment <- function(models,
                                             exp_design,
                                             wt_name = "WT",
                                             time_range = NULL,
                                             top_n = 200,
                                             eps = 1e-6,
                                             rank_by = c("padj_then_abslogfc",
                                                         "abslogfc_then_padj"),
                                             verbose = TRUE) {
  rank_by <- match.arg(rank_by)
  stopifnot(wt_name %in% names(models))

  # WT expression
  E_wt <- .get_expr(models, wt_name, time_range)
  if (is.null(E_wt)) stop("WT has no cells in the given time_range.")

  # only genes present in exp_design
  genes0 <- intersect(colnames(E_wt), colnames(exp_design))
  E_wt <- E_wt[, genes0, drop = FALSE]

  exps <- setdiff(rownames(exp_design), wt_name)

  if (verbose) {
    pb <- progress_bar$new(
      format = "WT vs KO DE [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta: :eta",
      total = length(exps), clear = FALSE, width = 70
    )
  }

  out <- vector("list", length(exps))
  names(out) <- exps

  for (e in exps) {
    if (verbose) pb$tick()
    if (!e %in% names(models)) next
    if (e == "HUB_WT") next

    # KO expression
    E_ko <- .get_expr(models, e, time_range)
    if (is.null(E_ko)) next

    # align genes
    g <- intersect(colnames(E_wt), colnames(E_ko))
    E_wt_g <- E_wt[, g, drop = FALSE]
    E_ko_g <- E_ko[, g, drop = FALSE]

    # ignore intervened genes
    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[exp_design[e, ] != 0]
    keep <- setdiff(g, pert_genes)
    if (!length(keep)) next

    E_wt_g <- E_wt_g[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    E_ko_g <- E_ko_g[, keep, drop = FALSE]

    # ---- logFC (ratio on log1p space) ----
    mu_wt <- colMeans(E_wt_g, na.rm = TRUE)
    mu_ko <- colMeans(E_ko_g, na.rm = TRUE)

    logfc <- log2((mu_ko + eps) / (mu_wt + eps))

    # ---- Wilcoxon p-values ----
    pvals <- vapply(seq_along(keep), function(j) {
      wilcox.test(E_ko_g[, j], E_wt_g[, j])$p.value
    }, numeric(1))
    names(pvals) <- keep

    padj <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")

    dt <- data.frame(
      experiment = e,
      gene = keep,
      logfc = as.numeric(logfc[keep]),
      pval = as.numeric(pvals[keep]),
      padj = as.numeric(padj[keep]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # rank and select top N
    if (rank_by == "padj_then_abslogfc") {
      dt <- dt[order(dt$padj, -abs(dt$logfc)), ]
    } else {
      dt <- dt[order(-abs(dt$logfc), dt$padj), ]
    }

    out[[e]] <- head(dt, top_n)
  }

  out
}

```

```{r}
k_hop_descendants <- function(A, sources, k = 1) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)
  sources <- unique(sources)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  frontier <- sources
  visited[frontier] <- TRUE

  desc <- integer(0)

  for (step in seq_len(k)) {
    # children of current frontier: edges frontier -> child
    kids <- which(colSums(A[frontier, , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    kids <- setdiff(kids, which(visited))
    if (!length(kids)) break
    desc <- c(desc, kids)
    visited[kids] <- TRUE
    frontier <- kids
  }
  unique(desc)
}
```


```{r}
score_graph_vs_de <- function(de_top200_list,
                              A,
                              exp_design,
                              step = 1,
                              top_x = NULL,
                              exp_subset = NULL) {
  genes <- colnames(exp_design)
  gene_to_idx <- setNames(seq_along(genes), genes)

  # decide which experiments to use
  exps <- names(de_top200_list)
  if (!is.null(exp_subset)) {
    exps <- intersect(exps, exp_subset)
  }

  res <- data.frame()

  for (e in exps) {
    dt <- de_top200_list[[e]]
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next

    # -----------------------------
    # select top X genes if needed
    # -----------------------------
    if (!is.null(top_x)) {
      dt <- head(dt, top_x)
    }

    # true set
    S_true <- dt$gene
    S_true_idx <- gene_to_idx[S_true]

    # perturbed genes in experiment
    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[which(exp_design[e, , drop = TRUE] != 0)]
    pert_idx <- gene_to_idx[pert_genes]

    # predicted set: k-hop descendants of perturbed genes
    S_pred_idx <- k_hop_descendants(A, sources = pert_idx, k = step)

    # exclude intervened genes
    S_pred_idx <- setdiff(S_pred_idx, pert_idx)

    # map back to gene names
    S_pred <- genes[S_pred_idx]

    # overlaps
    inter <- intersect(S_true, S_pred)
    uni <- union(S_true, S_pred)

    precision <- if (length(S_pred) == 0) NA_real_ else length(inter) / length(S_pred)
    recall <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else length(inter) / length(S_true)
    jaccard <- if (length(uni) == 0) NA_real_ else length(inter) / length(uni)

    res <- rbind(
      res,
      data.frame(
        experiment = e,
        step = step,
        top_x = ifelse(is.null(top_x), nrow(dt), top_x),
        n_true = length(S_true),
        n_pred = length(S_pred),
        n_intersect = length(inter),
        precision = precision,
        recall = recall,
        jaccard = jaccard,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  res
}
```

```{r}
sample_graph_with_precision_recall <- function(adj_true,
                                                target_precision = NULL,
                                                target_recall = NULL) {
  stopifnot(xor(is.null(target_precision), is.null(target_recall)))

  A <- adj_true
  p <- nrow(A)

  true_edges <- which(A == 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
  false_edges <- which(A == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)

  n_true <- nrow(true_edges)

  if (!is.null(target_recall)) {
    # fix recall, precision free
    n_tp <- ceiling(target_recall * n_true)
    tp_idx <- true_edges[sample(seq_len(n_true), n_tp), , drop = FALSE]

    # include all selected TPs only
    A_new <- matrix(0, p, p)
    A_new[tp_idx] <- 1
  }

  if (!is.null(target_precision)) {
    # fix precision, recall free
    # precision = TP / (TP + FP)
    # FP = TP * (1 - prec) / prec
    n_tp <- n_true
    n_fp <- ceiling(n_tp * (1 - target_precision) / target_precision)

    fp_idx <- false_edges[sample(seq_len(nrow(false_edges)), n_fp), , drop = FALSE]

    A_new <- adj_true
    A_new[fp_idx] <- 1
  }

  A_new
}

```

```{r}
    df_true
  })
)

  scores_fix_precision_all,
  scores_fix_precision_merged
)
```

# Try upstream negative score


```{r}
k_hop_ancestors <- function(A, targets, k = 1) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)
  targets <- unique(targets)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  frontier <- targets
  visited[frontier] <- TRUE

  anc <- integer(0)

  for (step in seq_len(k)) {
    # parents of current frontier: edge parent -> frontier
    parents <- which(rowSums(A[, frontier, drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    parents <- setdiff(parents, which(visited))
    if (!length(parents)) break
    anc <- c(anc, parents)
    visited[parents] <- TRUE
    frontier <- parents
  }
  unique(anc)
}


all_upstream <- function(A, targets) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  stack <- targets
  visited[stack] <- TRUE

  anc <- integer(0)

  while (length(stack)) {
    parents <- which(rowSums(A[, stack, drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    parents <- setdiff(parents, which(visited))
    if (!length(parents)) break
    anc <- c(anc, parents)
    visited[parents] <- TRUE
    stack <- parents
  }
  unique(anc)
}


score_negative_upstream <- function(de_list,
                                    A,
                                    exp_design,
                                    step = NULL,      # NULL = all upstream
                                    top_x = NULL,
                                    exp_subset = NULL) {

  genes <- colnames(exp_design)
  gene_to_idx <- setNames(seq_along(genes), genes)

  exps <- names(de_list)
  if (!is.null(exp_subset)) {
    exps <- intersect(exps, exp_subset)
  }

  res <- data.frame()

  for (e in exps) {
    dt <- de_list[[e]]
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next

    if (!is.null(top_x)) {
      dt <- head(dt, top_x)
    }

    # top-X DEGs
    S_true <- dt$gene
    S_true_idx <- gene_to_idx[S_true]

    # perturbed nodes
    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[exp_design[e, ] != 0]
    pert_idx <- gene_to_idx[pert_genes]

    # upstream set
    S_up_idx <- if (is.null(step)) {
      all_upstream(A, pert_idx)
    } else {
      k_hop_ancestors(A, pert_idx, k = step)
    }

    # exclude directly perturbed nodes
    S_up_idx <- setdiff(S_up_idx, pert_idx)
    S_up <- genes[S_up_idx]

    # negative overlap
    n_bad <- length(intersect(S_true, S_up))

    neg_score <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else n_bad / length(S_true)

    res <- rbind(
      res,
      data.frame(
        experiment = e,
        step = ifelse(is.null(step), "all", step),
        top_x = length(S_true),
        n_bad_overlap = n_bad,
        negative_score = neg_score,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  res
}
```

```{r}
make_partial_graph <- function(adj_truth, correct_frac, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  A <- adj_truth
  p <- nrow(A)

  # 所有可能的有向边（不含自环）
  all_edges <- which(row(A) != col(A), arr.ind = TRUE)

  # True edges
  true_edges <- which(A == 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
  E <- nrow(true_edges)

  # False edges = 非真实边
  false_edges <- all_edges[!apply(all_edges, 1, function(x)
    any(x[1] == true_edges[, 1] & x[2] == true_edges[, 2])
  ), , drop = FALSE]

  n_keep <- round(correct_frac * E)
  n_flip <- E - n_keep

  keep_idx <- sample(seq_len(E), n_keep)
  keep_edges <- true_edges[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]

  new_edges <- false_edges[sample(seq_len(nrow(false_edges)), n_flip), , drop = FALSE]

  # build new adjacency
  A_new <- matrix(0, p, p)
  A_new[keep_edges] <- 1
  A_new[new_edges] <- 1

  A_new
}
```

```{r}
calc_scores_for_graphs <- function(graph_list,
                                   de_list,
                                   exp_design,
                                   top_x_vals,
                                   exp_subset = NULL,
                                   step = NULL,
                                   graph_group = NULL) {
  # graph_list: named list of adjacency matrices
  # de_list: list of DE tables by experiment
  # exp_design: design matrix (rows=experiments, cols=genes)
  # top_x_vals: vector, e.g. seq(10, 50, by = 10)
  # exp_subset: optional vector of experiment names
  # step: NULL means all upstream (as in your score_negative_upstream)
  # graph_group: optional label for grouping, e.g. "low"/"high"

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(graph_list), function(name) {
    A <- graph_list[[name]]

    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(top_x_vals, function(tx) {
      score_negative_upstream(
        de_list   = de_list,
        A         = A,
        exp_design = exp_design,
        step      = step,
        top_x     = tx,
        exp_subset = exp_subset
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          graph = name,
          graph_group = graph_group,
          top_x = tx
        )
    }))
  }))
}
```

# update the score, now we need to consider siblings as well,so any gene not in the downstream will be penalized

```{r}
k_hop_descendants <- function(A, targets, k = 1) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)
  targets <- unique(targets)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  frontier <- targets
  visited[frontier] <- TRUE

  desc <- integer(0)

  for (step in seq_len(k)) {

    # children of current frontier: edge frontier -> child
    children <- which(colSums(A[frontier, , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    children <- setdiff(children, which(visited))

    if (!length(children)) break

    desc <- c(desc, children)
    visited[children] <- TRUE
    frontier <- children
  }

  unique(desc)
}


all_downstream <- function(A, targets) {
  A <- as.matrix(A)
  p <- ncol(A)

  visited <- rep(FALSE, p)
  stack <- targets
  visited[stack] <- TRUE

  desc <- integer(0)

  while (length(stack)) {

    children <- which(colSums(A[stack, , drop = FALSE]) > 0)
    children <- setdiff(children, which(visited))

    if (!length(children)) break

    desc <- c(desc, children)
    visited[children] <- TRUE
    stack <- children
  }

  unique(desc)
}



score_downstream <- function(de_list,
                                      A,
                                      exp_design,
                                      step = NULL,     # NULL = all downstream
                                      top_x = NULL,
                                      exp_subset = NULL) {

  genes <- colnames(exp_design)
  gene_to_idx <- setNames(seq_along(genes), genes)

  exps <- names(de_list)
  if (!is.null(exp_subset)) {
    exps <- intersect(exps, exp_subset)
  }

  res <- data.frame()

  for (e in exps) {

    dt <- de_list[[e]]
    if (is.null(dt) || !nrow(dt)) next

    if (!is.null(top_x)) {
      dt <- head(dt, top_x)
    }

    # top DEGs
    S_true <- dt$gene
    S_true_idx <- gene_to_idx[S_true]

    # perturbed nodes
    pert_genes <- colnames(exp_design)[exp_design[e, ] != 0]
    pert_idx <- gene_to_idx[pert_genes]

    # downstream set
    S_down_idx <- if (is.null(step)) {
      all_downstream(A, pert_idx)
    } else {
      k_hop_descendants(A, pert_idx, k = step)
    }

    # exclude perturbed nodes themselves
    S_down_idx <- setdiff(S_down_idx, pert_idx)
    S_down <- genes[S_down_idx]

    # DEGs NOT explained by downstream
    n_bad <- length(setdiff(S_true, S_down))

    neg_score <- if (length(S_true) == 0) NA_real_ else n_bad / length(S_true)

    res <- rbind(
      res,
      data.frame(
        experiment = e,
        step = ifelse(is.null(step), "all", step),
        top_x = length(S_true),
        n_outside_downstream = n_bad,
        negative_score = neg_score,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  res
}

```

```{r}
calc_scores_for_graphs <- function(graph_list,
                                   de_list,
                                   exp_design,
                                   top_x_vals,
                                   exp_subset = NULL,
                                   step = NULL,
                                   graph_group = NULL) {
  # graph_list: named list of adjacency matrices
  # de_list: list of DE tables by experiment
  # exp_design: design matrix (rows=experiments, cols=genes)
  # top_x_vals: vector, e.g. seq(10, 50, by = 10)
  # exp_subset: optional vector of experiment names
  # step: NULL means all upstream (as in your score_negative_upstream)
  # graph_group: optional label for grouping, e.g. "low"/"high"

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(graph_list), function(name) {
    A <- graph_list[[name]]

    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(top_x_vals, function(tx) {
      score_downstream(
        de_list   = de_list,
        A         = A,
        exp_design = exp_design,
        step      = step,
        top_x     = tx,
        exp_subset = exp_subset
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          graph = name,
          graph_group = graph_group,
          top_x = tx
        )
    }))
  }))
}
```

```{r}
  score_downstream(
    de_top200,

    exp_design,
    step = 1,
    top_x = tx,
    exp_subset = test_exp
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      graph = "Truth",
      top_x = tx
    )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
```

# filter de_top200 and sort it by log2fc

```{r}
de_top200_filtered <- map(de_top200, function(df) {

  # compute 90% quantile of absolute logFC within this table
  q95 <- quantile(abs(df$logfc), probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

  df %>%
    filter(abs(logfc) >= q95) %>%        # keep top 10% effect sizes
    filter(pval < 0.05) %>%              # significance filter
    arrange(desc(logfc))                 # sort by logFC (largest positive first)
})
```


```{r}
calc_scores_for_graphs <- function(graph_list,
                                   de_list,
                                   exp_design,
                                   step_vals,
                                   top_x,
                                   exp_subset = NULL,
                                   graph_group = NULL) {

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(graph_list), function(name) {
    A <- graph_list[[name]]

    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(step_vals, function(st) {
      score_downstream(
        de_list    = de_list,
        A          = A,
        exp_design = exp_design,
        step       = st,
        top_x      = top_x,
        exp_subset = exp_subset
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          graph = name,
          graph_group = graph_group,
         step = as.character(ifelse(is.null(st), "all", st)),
          top_x = top_x
        )
    }))
  }))
}
```

```{r}
# --- 4) p-value annotation (bottom-right of each panel) ---
pvals_high_annot <- pvals_high %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    step  = factor(step, levels = levels(scores_high_plot$step)),
    graph = factor(partial, levels = levels(scores_high_plot$graph)),
    x = "Partial",
    y = 0
  )


# --- 5) Plot: 5 (top_x) × 4 (partial%) panels, each panel has 2 groups ---
p_high <- ggplot(
  scores_high_plot,
  aes(x = group, y = negative_score, fill = group)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.4) +

  facet_grid(
    step ~ graph,
    scales = "fixed"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Truth"   = "#1b9e77",
      "Partial" = "#d95f02"
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +

  geom_text(
    data = pvals_high_annot,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = p_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = -0.2,
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +

  ylab("Causal Reach Violation") +
  ggtitle("Truth vs Partial graphs by causal depth\nPaired Wilcoxon per step")

print(p_high)
```

```{r}
pvals_low <- wide_low %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Truth), !is.na(Partial)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(step, partial) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(
      x = Truth,
      y = Partial,
      paired = TRUE,
      alternative = "less"
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_label = paste0("p = ", formatC(p_value, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
```
